title: Order confirmation sent to the customer
steps: As the owner, confirm the order from R3.8.
expected: The customer gets a message like "<Business> confirmed your order. Please pay through [payment link]." with your business's name. The order's status updates to confirmed.
notes: The payment platform is out of scope, so a placeholder link is fine.
SMS isn't live yet (pending network integration). On web, check where the message shows up and note it. Mark Blocked if you can't see it anywhere.

title: Ready-for-pickup message
steps: As the owner, mark the order as fulfilled or ready.
expected: The customer gets "Your order is ready for pickup." and the order's status updates.
notes: SMS isn't live yet (pending network integration). On web, check where the message shows up and note it. Mark Blocked if you can't see it anywhere.

title: Follow-up on a canceled order
steps: As a visitor, start a new order and leave without confirming (or cancel it).
expected: The customer gets a follow-up like "Would you like to finish your order with <Business>?" and the order's status shows it wasn't completed.
notes: SMS isn't live yet (pending network integration). On web, check where the message shows up and note it. Mark Blocked if you can't see it anywhere.

title: Order history is kept in memory
steps: After R4.1–R4.3, check each order in memory.
expected: Each order keeps its history: the status changes are recorded in order, and the total price is still correct.
